root.name: Alekhine Defense: Kmoch Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 Nf6 2. e5 Nd5 3. Bc4 Nb6 4. Bb3 c5 5. d3

overview: White attacks the b6 knight with Bc4-b3 and, after ...c5, plays the quiet 5.d3 rather than e6. Black continues ...N8c6 or ...d6 and White keeps the e5 pawn. A space-gaining structure with Black counterplay on the e5 pawn.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the e5 pawn with d3 and Nf3

typical_structures.structure: White e5 pawn against Black's hypermodern centre

character.notes: Quiet manoeuvring against an advanced pawn.

structure.notes: The e5 pawn is attacked and can be exchanged, so it stays tense.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.e6
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 Nf6 2. e5 Nd5 3. Bc4 Nb6 4. Bb3 c5 5. e6

character.reason: The play is positional with no forcing lines.

structure.reason: The e5 pawn is attacked and the centre is not fixed.

approach.reason: A normal line of the Alekhine.

plans.reason: White has space and Black undermines.
